name: remote_ok-jobs-mcp
description: Remote OK (jobs): search. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Single keyless JSON array with no documented query, location, page or limit parameters: nothing is sent and the whole feed (a few hundred rows) is returned; filter client-side. Element 0 of the feed is the legal notice (id null) and is dropped by the runtime. Fields per the feed: slug, id, epoch, date, company, company_logo, position, tags[], description (HTML), location, apply_url, salary_min, salary_max, url; currency is not stated. Attribution: link back (follow) to the Remote OK URL and name Remote OK as the source.
